name: Panama
snapshot: Under pressure from Trump, Panama's Supreme Court voided Hong Kong's CK Hutchison's contracts for the canal's two main ports, and the state took them over with Maersk as temporary operator.
culture: The canal shapes Panamanian identity; the 1999 handover from the US is a national milestone. Indigenous Guna people of the San Blas islands make the colourful mola textiles. Panama City's old quarter, Casco Viejo, sits across the bay from a skyline of banking towers. Rubén Blades made salsa a vehicle for political storytelling.
society: The canal, banking, logistics and a large free trade zone make Panama one of Latin America's richest countries per head, but inequality is high. In 2023 mass protests forced the closure of a giant copper mine. Droughts have cut canal traffic, prompting plans for a new reservoir.
situation: In January 2025, Donald Trump said in his inaugural address that China was operating the Panama Canal and that the United States would take it back. Panama, which spent most of the 20th century fighting to recover the canal from the US, insisted the waterway was its own. In 2026 it removed the thing Trump had pointed at, while trying to make it look like Panama's choice.

The target was two ports at either end of the canal, Balboa on the Pacific and Cristóbal on the Atlantic, run since 1997 by a subsidiary of Hong Kong's CK Hutchison, a conglomerate built by Li Ka-shing. They handled about 38 percent of Panama's container traffic. On 29 January, Panama's Supreme Court declared the concession unconstitutional for granting exclusive privileges and tax breaks; China promised to protect its companies, and Hutchison filed for international arbitration (AFP via CRHoy). On 23 February, President José Raúl Mulino ordered the state to temporarily take over the ports, with Denmark's Maersk running them in the transition (Bloomberg Law). Mulino said Panama "will not allow itself to be threatened by any country on earth" and that the ports would never again go to a single operator (Reuters via Yahoo). The ruling also left Hutchison's planned sale of its global ports business, which had a US-backed buyer, in limbo. A small country carrying about 5 percent of world shipping trade had become a front line in the US-China rivalry.
power: A presidential republic. The president is directly elected for a single five-year term by simple plurality and heads the government; the 71-seat National Assembly is unicameral. The canal itself is run by an autonomous authority.
holders: President José Raúl Mulino (Realizando Metas), in office since 2024.
